title: A moment-based approach to the injective norm of random tensors
summary: In this paper, we present a technically simple method to establish upper bounds on the expected injective norm of real and complex random tensors. Our approach is somewhat analogous to the moment method in random matrix theory, and is based on a deterministic upper bound on the injective norm of a tensor which might be of independent interest.
